packet.headline_seed: Russian fighters confirm withdrawal from northern Mali city after separatist attacks
packet.description_seed: Ethnic Tuareg fighters say they are in control of Kidal following a weekend of nationwide attacks, alongside Islamist groups.

what: Russian fighters confirm withdrawal from northern Mali city after separatist attacks

clean_source_blocks.text: Ethnic Tuareg fighters say they are in control of Kidal following a weekend of nationwide attacks, alongside Islamist groups.

After a weekend of co-ordinated attacks across Mali by separatist fighters and Islamist militants, Russian forces who are in the country helping protect the military government have confirmed they have pulled out of the northern city of Kidal.

This comes after the group – which seeks a breakaway ethnic Tuareg state in the north – took part in co-ordinated attacks by armed groups across Mali, including the capital, Bamako, on Saturday. Mali’s Defence Minister Sadio Camara was killed in the attacks near Bamako, according to his family and French media.

Russian mercenaries hired by Mali’s military have agreed to withdraw from Kidal after two days of clashes, the country’s separatist Azawad Liberation Front (FLA) group has said, as it claims to control the city.
